name: estate-platform
description: Web platform for a real estate agency dealing primarily in land plots

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run --if-present test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
